title: Interior biased probability level
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone and nonconstant, and let $\alpha\in(0,1)$. Let $p_*$ be the unique number in $(0,1)$ for which the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ at parameter $p_*$ equals $\alpha$. Then $p_*\in(0,1)$.
